name: gaia-quick-curate
description: Inspect or exercise the paused gaia curate orchestration scaffold for one source URL. The command persists an INITIALIZED run ledger and reports status. Its former transition stubs were pruned, so no automated curation or merge pipeline runs. Outward discovery belongs to /gaia-frontier, and manual L4-gated curation is supported via /gaia-full-pipeline or /gaia-consult. Use only for scaffold development, status inspection, or dry-run contract work. Trigger phrases: "/gaia-quick-curate", "inspect gaia curate", "curate scaffold", "quick curate status". For batch/multi-page runs use gaia-curate-dynamic; for crawler branches use gaia-bot-curate; for pending intake proposals use gaia-draft-curate.
